steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: intercept-window-open
steps.eval: window.open = () => ({ document: { write(h) { window.__capturedHtml = h }, close() {} }, close() {}, focus() {}, print() {} })

steps.name: assert-locked-scale-and-title-block
steps.eval: (() => { const html = window.__capturedHtml; const need = (re, label) => { if (!re.test(html)) throw new Error('missing: ' + label) }; need(/Scale 1:\d+ @ A4 LANDSCAPE/, 'locked scale ratio + paper/orientation'); need(/@page \{ size: A4 landscape;/, 'A4 landscape @page CSS'); need(/Scale NTS/, 'NTS on schedule/cover sheets'); need(/class="plan-svg" style="width:[\d.]+mm;height:[\d.]+mm"/, 'mm-true floor-plan sizing'); need(/Serangoon North Vista Reno/, 'project name'); need(/123 Serangoon North Ave 1/, 'project address'); need(/Tan Family/, 'client'); need(/J\. Lim/, 'drawn by'); need(/Checked:/, 'checked-by field'); need(/Rev B/, 'revision letter'); need(/Issued for tender/, 'revision note'); need(/A-1 of \d+/, 'sheet number of total'); need(/General notes/, 'general notes block'); need(/Do NOT scale drawings from screen or PDF/, 'print-at-100% disclaimer'); need(/HDB permit/, 'HDB permit disclaimer'); need(/Professional Engineer \(PE\)/, 'PE disclaimer'); need(/EMA-Licensed Electrical Worker \(LEW\)/, 'LEW disclaimer'); need(/PUB Licensed Plumber/, 'PUB plumber disclaimer'); window.__scenarioOk = true; })()

steps.name: verify-mm-math-for-a-known-wall
steps.eval: (() => { const html = window.__capturedHtml; const plan = window.__store.getState().floorPlan; const ratioMatch = html.match(/Scale 1:(\d+) @ A4/); if (!ratioMatch) throw new Error('no scale ratio found'); const ratio = Number(ratioMatch[1]); const mmPerM = 1000 / ratio; const wall = plan.walls.find((w) => { const dx = w.end[0]-w.start[0], dz = w.end[1]-w.start[1]; return Math.hypot(dx, dz) > 0.01 }); if (!wall) throw new Error('no wall found'); const lenM = Math.hypot(wall.end[0]-wall.start[0], wall.end[1]-wall.start[1]); const expectedMm = lenM * mmPerM; const actualMm = lenM * (1000 / ratio); if (Math.abs(actualMm - expectedMm) > 0.001) throw new Error('mm-math mismatch: ' + actualMm + ' vs ' + expectedMm); window.__mmMathOk = true; })()

steps.name: stash-a4-html-and-ratio
steps.eval: window.__a4Html = window.__capturedHtml; window.__a4Ratio = Number(window.__capturedHtml.match(/Scale 1:(\d+) @ A4/)[1]); window.__capturedHtml = undefined

steps.name: switch-to-a3-paper
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setDrawingSetTemplate({ ...s.drawingSetTemplate, paperSize: 'a3', orientation: 'landscape' }) })()

steps.name: assert-a3-title-block-and-finer-scale
steps.eval: (() => { const html = window.__capturedHtml; if (!/Scale 1:\d+ @ A3 LANDSCAPE/.test(html)) throw new Error('missing A3 LANDSCAPE scale label'); if (!/@page \{ size: A3 landscape;/.test(html)) throw new Error('@page CSS not parameterized to A3 landscape'); const a3Ratio = Number(html.match(/Scale 1:(\d+) @ A3/)[1]); if (!(a3Ratio <= window.__a4Ratio)) throw new Error('A3 ratio ' + a3Ratio + ' is not finer-or-equal to A4 ratio ' + window.__a4Ratio); window.__a3Html = html; window.__a3ScenarioOk = true; })()
